1

Convert the following to date or date/time objects.

a) September 13, 2010.

b) Sept 13, 2010.

c) Sep 13, 2010.

d) S 13, 2010. Comment on the month abbreviation needs.

e) 07-Dec-1941.

f) 1-5-1998. Comment on why you might be wrong.

g) 21-5-1998. Comment on why you know you are correct.

h) 2020-May-5 10:30 am

i) 2020-May-5 10:30 am PDT (ex Seattle)

j) 2020-May-5 10:30 am AST (ex Puerto Rico)

1a
```{r}
a <- ymd("2010-9-13")
format(a, "%B %d, %Y")
```

1b
```{r}
b <- ymd("2010-9-13")
format(b, "%bt %d, %Y")
```
r does not recognize Sept, only September or Sep so I put a t after %b

1c
```{r}
c <- ymd("2010-9-13")
format(c, "%b %d, %Y")
```

1d
```{r}
d <- ymd("2010-9-13")
format(d, "S %d, %Y")
```
Can't get the month to abbreviate to S so I left out the format convertor and instead put an S


1e
```{r}
e<- ymd("1941-12-07")
format(e, "%d-%b-%Y")
```

1f
```{r}
f <- mdy("1-5-1998")
format(f, "%m-%d-%Y")
```
I might be wrong because I don't know whether the month is supposed to be January or May

1g
```{r}
g <- ymd("1998-5-21")
format(g, "%d-%m-%Y")
```
You can't confuse month and day with this problem

1h
```{r}
h <- ymd_hm("2020-5-5 10:30 AM")
format(h, "%Y-%B-%d %I:%M %p")
```

1i
```{r}
i <- ymd_hm("2020-5-5 10:30 AM", tz='America/Los_Angeles')
format(i, "%Y-%B-%d %I:%M %p %Z")
```

1j
```{r}
j <- ymd_hm("2020-5-5 10:30 AM", tz='America/Puerto_Rico')
format(j, "%Y-%B-%d %I:%M %p %Z")
```

2

Using your date of birth (ex Sep 7, 1998) and today’s date calculate the following Write your code in a manner that the code will work on any date after you were born.:

a) Calculate the date of your 64th birthday.

b) Calculate your current age (in years). Hint: Check your age is calculated correctly if your birthday was yesterday and if it were tomorrow!

c) Using your result in part (b), calculate the date of your next birthday.

d) The number of days until your next birthday.

f) The number of months and days until your next birthday.

2a
```{r}
dob <- make_date(year = 2005, month = 12, day = 29)
dob + years(64)
```


2b
```{r}
current <- lubridate::today()
current_age = interval(dob, current)
as.period(current_age)
```


2c
```{r}
nextbd <- make_date(year = 2026, month = 12, day = 29)
bday = interval(current, nextbd)
as.period(bday)
```


2d
```{r}
as.period(bday, unit = 'days')
```


2e
```{r}
p <- as.period(bday)
paste(month(p), "months and", day(p), "days")
```


3
```{r}
call <- ymd_hms("2025-05-08 15:00:00", tz = "America/Phoenix")
format(call, tz = "Pacific/Auckland")
```
